notes.title: Vai5000 Update
notes.content:
Vai5000 joins Hyperhell as the 10th playable character! She summons memories which both block oncoming damage when nearby, and can be used offensively to create short range explosions! Her starting weapon is the NEURA BLASTER which is a reloadable 6 shot rocket revolver that fires as fast as you can click.

You can unlock Vai by taking any devil deal with a goat, or by typing [spoiler]oath5000[/spoiler] on the main menu. You can also unlock everything in the entire game by [spoiler]pressing 1 and 9 at the same time on the main menu.[/spoiler]

Showcase vid here

-New character: Vai5000
5HP, 3SPD
= ability: memory - takes dmg for you when near
+ shoot memory to summon friendly projectiles
- memories destroyed when taking damage nearby
- starting gun needs to reload

-Tracey buff: CRANKIN DAT SCYTHE
Tracey Brakes can now press R to "crank" her scythe. This makes the next singular attack gain slightly more speed/range, at the cost of some slime. This can be stacked multiple times, meaning you can crank like 5 times to get a melee attack that goes across the entire screen. This is really strong for dealing with problem enemies like snipers and makes the Reagan fight a bit more dynamic.

-New temporary buff: RAGE
Explode into spikes whenever you take damage. Particularly good when combined with Vai's RMB ability that lets her take hits without losing health.

-New temporary buff: STINKY
Causes protective flies to be summoned upon picking up any item. Flies go away when travelling to a new level.

-New temporary buff: RABID
Gain a 45% fire rate bonus while you have an active combo of 5x or higher. Very fun on Fraxiom, you can get an absolutely stupid fire rate bonus with her RMB.

-New contract: PROPEL
Changes recoil to work more like folie's dash, where you get pushed for multiple frames. Very fun, especially on Tracey since her recoil pushes her forwards!

-GLASS contract overhaul: changed to DEVOUR
Previously GLASS would give 3x bullet power but double all damage taken. I thought this was too harsh a penalty so it now triples hunger instead. Renamed it to DEVOUR since glass doesn't really make sense as a name anymore.

-Blacksmith overhaul
The blacksmith now rerolls your weapon's projectile instead of applying a weapon tag. Because this is EXTREMELY powerful, he now won't spawn until you've killed Reagan at least once and you can only interact with him once each time he spawns.

-Shopkeeper tweaks
Shopkeepers can now be killed more than once! Killing a shopkeeper now also no longer makes future shops stay closed. However, each time you kill a shopkeeper, the fight becomes slightly harder. Shopkeepers can now also give all characters guns AND powerups.

-Tweaked some challenge cheat codes to be more evil
The cheat code "painpainpain" is now much more brutal, in addition to previous modifiers (way more heat, harder bosses) it now also gives all enemy projectiles more health, makes events (minibosses, clusters, etc) significantly more likely to spawn, and makes bosses spawn minibosses.
I also added a cheat code "skip100" which skips you to 4-100 at the start of your run. Now you can type "painpainpain", "skip100", and "chaoscontrol" to make your game completely unplayable!! ("vanilla" on the main menu to disable all cheats, or reboot game)

-Lots of QOL tweaks + bugfixes:
fixed tumult being free
buff sleepy by making it increase wait time between attacks for bosses
fix the DINKDINKDINK from coffins
buff clogger enemies
fixed bug where all yellow projectiles were parryable
slightly buffed bubble Darryl - more projectiles, less accurate
boss death voicelines now properly cut off taunts
made metalworker temp buff not spawn for tracey/grungo
buff charging railgun - it charges 50% faster and shoots 2x as many projectiles
item drops and level exits no longer get stuck in walls
clusters spawn a bit closer together, and no longer spawn in the middle of walls
parried objects (melee, barrels) now have a minimum parried projectile speed
fixed a glitchy contract spawnpoint on office
priests now drop a small passive buff container on death instead of a heart
webcage turrets now unaffected by superslowmo
removed mechanic where characters w/ no gun drops could also not get guns from shops/chests/slots
hyper bullets now more heavily affects melee speed
hyper bullets now increases laser weapon's scale (this can stack with BEEG)
fixed contract reroll text from saying incorrect price, free items cheat now works with rerolls
added proper slime notches to b2b
fixed b2b instantly melee attacking/throwing enemies when unpausing
fixed b2b infinite ammo removing enemy when going through levels
efficient now affects b2b - half meter depleted when throwing enemies
fixed bug where spice contract would not get removed from cleansing pools

Thank you for continuing to play my game <3

notes.title: Vylet Pony Update
notes.content:
Top 5 Videos voiced by Vylet Pony joins Hyperhell as the 9th playable character! She uses the telekinesis from her horn to dual wield weapons, as well as the power of friendship to summon other ponies (vylet, dub, tiberuius, fluttgirshy) that assist in combat. Vid starts with a FULMINATED MERCURY launcher and has a lower base fire rate + gets less slime than all other characters.

You can unlock Vid by donating to the anti-Reagan resistance in 3-4 (more details on this below), or by typing [spoiler]crunklord3[/spoiler] on the main menu, alternatively you can unlock everything in the entire game (all characters + weapons) by [spoiler]pressing 1 and 9 at the same time on the main menu.[/spoiler]

Showcase vid here

-New character: Top 5 Videos
4HP, 4SPD
= ability: friendship - summon ponies
+ HOLD special to make pony go to cursor
+ dual wielding
- less fire rate, max hp, slime

-New enemy variance system + a TON of new enemies
There are now orange micromissile variants of all basic enemy types as well as several new special enemy archetypes and variants for each color. Instead of introducing them all the one giant enemy pool, the game picks a couple of the enemies to spawn earlier into the run and then adds more challenging variants of those enemies + the enemies it didn't spawn earlier later into the run. Basically, there's a lot of new enemy types (~50% more) but you won't see all of them on your first run because the enemies that do show up are slightly randomized each run.

-Donating to the anti-Reagan resistance
Spawning on 3-4 right before the Reagan fight, you can give this group your points and it will keep them between runs - providing long term benefits and unlocks the more you do this. At 5,000 points deposited, you will unlock the new character Vid. An additional 5k and 10k points after that will unlock more shops to give you options for the Reagan fight. Donate another 15k unlocks passive buff drops from enemies (detailed below) and 25k more points unlocks contract rerolls. Donating 40k points after that unlocks something special...

-New temporary buff system
Can be unlocked as enemy drops by donating between runs OR you can find shops that sell buffs to you after you've killed Reagan at least once. They last for less time if you find them from enemy drops and much longer if you buy them at a shop. Currently all the buffs you can find randomly are:
Abundance: enemies/bosses drop significantly more items
Metalworker: guns are significantly more likely to be tagged variants
Efficient: use 2x less slime
Sleepy: enemy projectile speed significantly decreased. Bosses currently unaffected.

-Devil deal rerolls
Also unlocked from the donation machine, these cost 1500 points and will reroll the current available contracts but will remove one option and any gilded contracts will become regular.

-Secret final donation machine reward
[spoiler]TUMULT - randomizes the current stage. Now you can play with post loop enemies on mall/office/mansion! Costs 1500pts and can only be enabled at 3-4. Pair this with the chaos contract for a borderline unplayable experience! :D[/spoiler]

-New weapon tag: BEEG - num projectiles and projectile size increased, fire rate lowered

-New contract: GLASS - 3x bullet power, 2x damage taken

-a TON of misc character tweaks
Frax: rmb cost decreased slightly: 1 -> 0.9
Gupi: ammo bonus nerfed 40% -> 25%, accuracy penalty increased 50% -> 100%, gain 20% less slime
Folie: bite size + bite speed increased, gets more slime from kills, cleansed buff nerf
Dj Recode: activating invincibility at full hp makes it last twice as long
Webcage: you can now hold rmb to throw turrets, default weapon buffed
Jelly B2B America: Default gun projectiles buffed 3 -> 5, hand fire rate lowered, hand range increased

-Shops are now SIGNIFICANTLY cheaper and their prices are randomized (~3x cheaper on average)

-Lots of QOL/balance tweaks/Bug fixes:
Bursting tag on burst weapons buffed
Brisk contract buffed from 1 -> 2 speed
Minibosses leave a big splatter on death now
Cleansing pools and contracts now have a brief buffer until they activate
Jerry Hernandez miniboss nerfed (he shoots less purple projectiles now)
Made loop 2 blood requirements easier
Added active contract/buff readouts to pause screen
Thunderbird tweaked to be a burst weapon
Fixed gupi snare not blocking some deceasedRa4/worm attacks
Fixed bumpers not reflecting hyper bullets
Fixed some B2B bugs where you could throw enemies while dead
Nerfed DeceasedRa4 black hole projectile HP
'How to unlock' messages now also show who you're unlocking
Piso now flees from bosses in a less annoying way
Added an in game timer for speedrunners, activated by typing "katigt" on the main menu
Rocket launcher enemies play a sound when firing now, tweaked player rocket noises as well
Fixed shops not closing properly at the start of the Reagan fight
Knifeball acts like a tier 2 and makes it harder to pick up regular crates, also it uses knife ammo on the hud now
Lowered fridge hp 15 -> 8
Fixed lightshow lasers not converging with webcage turrets

Thank you for continuing to play my game <3

notes.title: B2B Update hotfix
notes.content:

-Fixed crash with rare guns from shops

notes.title: Angel Jelly B2B America Loves Me Update
notes.content:
Angel Jelly and America Loves Me join the hyperhell roster as the 8th playable character! You control both artists at the same time, taking direct control of Angel Jelly with America Loves Me following you closely behind. Use LMB to pick up and throw enemies, creating a bigger explosion the more slime you have. Fill up the slime bar to completion for a devastating attack that goes through walls! RMB will have America Loves Me use their weapon, they're armed with the bald deagle by default, a red white and blue short range burst shotgun that pairs extremely well with Jelly's melee attacks.

You can unlock the pair by reaching extra spicy heat during a run, or with cheats by [spoiler] pressing 1 and 9 at the same time on the main menu to unlock everything. [/spoiler]

Showcase vid here

-New character: Angel Jelly B2B America Loves Me
5HP, 4SPD
= ability: collab - control two characters at once
+ grab/throw with lmb, more slime = more power
+ shoot from follower with rmb
- less ammo with weapons

-Fraxiom overhaul: several changes to rmb ability, base stats unaffected.
	rmb now automatically fires the weapon, you don't need to hold lmb + rmb anymore
	rmb now works on semi-automatic and charge weapons
	rmb base fire rate increase buffed
	rmb fire rate increase becomes more powerful the longer you hold rmb down

-Massive Gupi buffs:
	snare time increased from 1s to 2s
	snare now has little bar below character to show when stun runs out
	snare now deletes attacks bosses are in the middle of choreographing, like lasers + explosions
	shotgun buffed

-Reverted folie nerf, smg now shoots at same fire rate as previous updates.

-New weapon tag: Bursting - converts the weapon to burst fire, or doubles the burst length if was already a burst weapon.

-Enemies now rarely spawn in CLUSTERS of 3-6 enemies. This can happen on any level but becomes more common the further into a run you get.

-Devil dealers now drop cleansing pools instead of exit portals on death

-New contract: CLUSTER - significantly more clusters spawn, clusters contain more enemies

-One random contract will now be GILDED and give an addl 200pts

-New gun: Thunderbird
-New challenge: parry a rocket

-Abyss now can spawn pinball bumpers, explosive barrels, and gore nests

-2 new post loop boss arenas + tweaked player spawn locations to account for this

-Like, a LOT of QOL/bugfixes, including:
-fixed character select menu character descriptions
-added "reagan killed" to unlock all cheat
-fixed bug where game could drop a common gun and a portal from the same enemy
-breaking blood canisters now gives 25pts
-fixed a room in mansion that accidentally had way too many enemy spawn locations in it
-fixed a room in abyss that accidentally had way too many enemy spawn locations in it
-updated tutorial to match new frax abilities
-slight recode slime usage rate buff
-overlocked tag buff, it additionally gives 25% more ammo now
-knifeball nerf, 100 ammo => 50 ammo
-renamed "Ultra Murdergun" to "Ronald Ray Gun" because its funnier

Thank you for continuing to play my game <3

notes.title: Leviathan Update
notes.content:
The first archdevil is now fightable in the bottom-most depths of the infinite abyss. Featuring an exclusive song by the incredible DJ Re:Code not on any streaming services (yet), this fight should provide a challenge to even the most seasoned of players. Good luck!

-New Superboss. Spoilers on how to find it: [spoiler] You have to kill every coffin boss in one run and then open another coffin. This means the earliest it can be encountered is 4-9 and you have to open every coffin you come across. Good luck! [/spoiler]

-MASSIVE overhaul to the devil deals system.
-devil deals are now activated by boss kills, not combos.
-the sign telling you where the devil deal is has been removed.
-if you have killed reagan at least once before, a hud notification will tell you where the nearest deal is located.
-contracts no longer give a point bonus
-devil dealers will never spawn in murder city megamall

-New cleansing pool encounter! This spawns if you go to where a devil dealer would have spawned after already having killed him. Activating this with active contracts allows you to "cleanse" one of your choice which removes its effects and rewards you with a rare weapon. Activating this with no active contracts instead buffs your default weapon for 2 minutes. Activating a second cleansing pool with no contracts simply resets the timer.

-New contract: BRISK - +1 speed, -1 max health
-New contract: FLIGHT - significantly more moving enemies spawn

-New gun: Spray n Pray
-New Challenge: Kill the superboss

-DJ Re:Code buff, her deagle now shoots 3 projectiles, shoots slightly faster, and her ammo penalty has been removed

-Some QOL tweaks, such as:
moving enemies are worth an extra 5pts
different noise for picking up a semi vs automatic weapon
folie uzi tweak (slight nerf)

Thank you for continuing to play my game <3

notes.title: Dance & Deal Update
notes.content:
A dance dance devilution arcade cabinet has appeared in the office breakroom! Featuring two playable songs (+ possibly more in the future?) with a full scoring system and tweakable speeds, avatars, etc, this is (probably) our highest effort minigame yet!

But that's not all! The new devil deal system will give experienced players new varied challenges to face in their runs! Not to mention the new boss...

Showcase vid here

-New rhythm minigame with two playable songs, three avatars, adjustable song speed/note scroll speed, and input system.

-New devil deal system! Spoilers on how to unlock/use it: [spoiler] The second level of each area except the mall (2-2, 3-2, 4-2, 4-5, etc) you can find a goat where a boss would normally spawn. Entering the level with a 10x combo or higher will spawn a sign that points you in the direction of this goat. Upon reaching the goat, if you've gotten a 25x combo at any point during the run he will give you a choice between 3 deals that make the run harder but also make enemies drop 5 more points on kill. These stack, but each time you go to the goat the combo requirement is another 10 higher. [/spoiler]

-New secret boss! Spoilers on how to find it: [spoiler] Trigger the devil deal using the system described above, but instead of walking into a contract, shoot the goat instead. This can also be used to not take a devil deal if you don't get the one you want, however killing the goat means he can't spawn again during the run. [/spoiler]

-New rare weapon: Entropy Shotgun.
-New challenge: get 3 mutators at the same time.

-Moving enemies will now occasionally spawn post loop.

-Loads of new level and rhythm game music (4 new level songs, 2 new boss tracks, 2 new rhythm game songs)

-Massive gupi buff! Shotgun is improved, snare lasts longer, hp increased from 4 -> 5

-Folie nerf, max hp decreased from 5 -> 4

-Lategame health droprate increased (mostly affects max heat post loop)

-Boost pad overhaul, they temporarily increase move speed instead of flinging you

-Misc bugfixes, some crashes, some enemy projectile desync, etc.

-Booster bruce nerf, projectiles changed from yellow to red but he shoots more of them now

Thanks for playing, love yall <3

notes.title: Deceased Ra7 Update
notes.content:
Beware EDM sinners, Deceased Ra7 is here to troll the frick out of you!!!!
He spawns randomly from coffins so it might take a couple for him to spawn.

Voiced by the incredibly talented Yung Skrrt! Check out their brand new album: "I Am The Best In The World. You Don't Have To Believe Me."

Showcase vid here

-New boss: Deceased Ra7 - uses a combination of hitscan and slow moving high hp bullet attacks

-New miniboss: Jerry Hernandez - he can move and use hitscan!! voiced by the lead dev also lol

-Hyper bullets powerup buff: bullets now have 6x power instead of 5x and also pierce through enemy corpses instead of stopping when they hit one. This also applies to bosses, meaning regular bullets can hit bosses more than once.

-Cyber ceo overhaul: significantly less RNG based now, tracey brakes mains rejoice!

-Added knifeball: every time you pick up a butterfly knife, there is a 1/40 chance of it turning into a knifeball. Because the butterfly knife has ~1/20 chance of dropping in the first place, that means it has a ~1/800 chance of spawning from a blue crate once youve unlocked the butterfly knife. It is incredibly overpowered, might nerf it next update lol.

-Lots of small bugfixes/tweaks: terf wizard post loop shoots less yellow bombs, superslowmo is less buggy, heat gain during post loop has been capped to be more consistent, probably more im forgetting lol.

notes.title: Webcage update
notes.content:
Never before in my life has it felt exactly like this.

Webcage joins the Hyperhell roster!
Armed with a burst pistol and the ability to summon turrets, they make up for their slower speed with overwhelming ammo efficiency and smart use of multi-directional attacks.
You can unlock them by completing 5 challenges (if already done, just start a run normally and you'll unlock on spawn) or with cheats by [spoiler] pressing 1 and 9 on the main menu to unlock everything [/spoiler]

Showcase vid here

-New character: Webcage
5HP, 3SPD
= ability: turrets - duplicate current gun and set it on small turret which despawns after 10s or when it runs out of ammo
+ start with burst pistol
- slower than most

-New powerup: HYPER BULLETS, increases speed of all projectiles and multiplies their strength by 5. Lasts 16 seconds (longer than any other powerup!) 

-Reordered some challenges and added the new one to 'defeat 2 minibosses in the same stage'

-Tweaked post loop bosses to be less RNG based (land lord of the flies got a MASSIVE nerf post loop, terf wizard a normal nerf, and ceo borg a slight nerf. Thatcher is mostly unchanged)

-Keyboard rebinding added

-Cursor resizing added

-Fixed a really nasty bug where evil grungo + booster bruce would sometimes randomly crash the game, should hopefully be no more random crashes anymore

-Fixed a bunch of misc bugs (melee deleting itself on edge of map, FULL AUTO powerup being buggy, barrels being buggy and stopping slides, and more that I'm probably forgetting)

notes.title: 100+ gun update
notes.content:
I got gunz that make breakfast!

showcase vid here

-New weapon tag system: each weapon now has a chance to spawn as a 'variant' version. Current tags include:

 Overclocked - fires much faster, lower accuracy
 Heavy - fires way more bullets, but lower fire rate
 Cold - slower bullet speed, but more bullets/fire rate
 Legendary - slight increase to all stats


-New encounter: blacksmith
He will apply a variant tag to your current weapon or reroll it if you already have one.

-Mimic encounter rebalance
Mimic chance changed from 10 -> 6 -> 4 -> 2 to 6 -> 3 -> 2
real chests now drop a guaranteed variant gun

-New weapon: charging laser

-Vertical enemy rebalance: the enemies that shoot horizontal/vertical lines were kind of redundant so I combined the two into one enemy which change the direction of the lines based on your position

-8 brand new enemies (they don't show up until the office/mansion so you might not see them in your first run)

-Particle effects overhaul: gunfights are much messier now.

-Slight folie uzi nerf, slight dj re:code deagle buff

-Cloud saves! I haven't tested these at all so if they don't work hit me up on twitter and I'll patch it lol

-Bugfixes + QOL stuff I forgot to write down anywhere

notes.title: Pride/Tracey Brakes update
notes.content:
Tracey Brakes joins the Hyperhell roster as our first post release new character!
Armed with a comically large scythe and a grapple hook, she can be unlocked by getting a 20x combo during a run, or with cheats by [spoiler] Pressing 1 and 9 at the same time on the main menu (this unlocks everything!) [/spoiler]

Showcase vid:
here

-New character: Tracey Brakes
4 HP, 4SPD
= ability: grappling hook - hold rmb to pull yourself towards walls or to pull enemies towards you
+ start with giant scythe, scythe is slow but instantly recharges swing when you kill an enemy with it
- no gun pickups

-Added new FPS minigame in satan's megamansion, with a cameo from [spoiler] Lillith Walker/Bunlith, the lead developer of Bloodborne PSX/Bloodborne Kart! She was super fun to work with, shoutout to her, go play her games they're also free >:) [/spoiler]

-Two new starter weapons, DJ Re:Code now starts with a deagle and Folie now starts with an Uzi

-Some slight boss nerfs, mostly notably made reagan periodically lower his speed to rest which should make him easier to hit

-Multiple possible boss arena spawns per stage, should hopefully lead to more varied boss fights

-Two new minibosses, Booster Bruce and Fallen Angel

-Various QOL, such as:
Grungo buff (base heat lowered to 0)
Way more spawn points,
Abyss arena is a bit bigger,
Takes longer to pick up common guns while holding a rare gun,
More im forgetting, probably

notes.title: Bingle update
notes.content:
Finally............ bingle.
Showcase vid here

-Updated bingle npc to have voicelines, provided by the incredible maia arson crimew :)
You can find it in the fishing minigame which is accessed by [spoiler]breaking all 4 blood canisters in the mall[/spoiler]

-New weapon: Crescent Shotgun
-New challenge: defeat a shopkeeper

-Frax and Gupi will now do the caramelldansen after being idle for 2.5s

-Added new 'encounter' system where interactable npcs spawn occasionally throughout the map. These include:

1) the shop - spend score to get rare item! you can try to kill the shopkeeper for free swag but it'll shut you out of every shop for the rest of the run. Also the shopkeeper has a rocket launcher.

2) chests - every time you open a chest, the odds of the next one being a mimic increases!

3) slots - sacrifice 1HP for a chance to win a rare item. Beware that once you start gambling the slot machine will close after a couple seconds, so trying to go out and get more health to gamble with is risky! 

4) blood altar - summon up to 2 minibosses which drop loads of blood on death. you basically get to skip half the level, but taking on two bosses at once can be really tough!

-Added a guaranteed shop spawn right before the reagan fight, so you can enter the fight with a rare gun at the cost of like, half your score >:)

-Added 6 new minibosses which have a very low chance (literally like 1/1000) of spawning in place of regular enemies. These include: (spoilers)
[spoiler] murder meatball, evil grungo, lesser landlord, mimic, shopkeeper, and super murder meatball. [/spoiler]
The chance goes up significantly if you get to 4-10 though

-made it so on loop 3 and beyond, coffins now spawn additional minibosses

-Buffed gatling shotgun ammo, buffed davy crockett ROF, slightly nerfed cube gun ROF

notes.title: 1.6 - Thatcher bossfight update
notes.content:
Margaret Thatcher has resurrected from the grave! You can find her as one of the new coffin bosses that have a chance to spawn each run. Since coffin bosses are random, it might take a run or two for her to spawn.

Thatcher is voiced by the incredible htmljones :) go watch their interview with maia arson crimew that just came out on youtube its really good

Steam wont let me embed this youtube link since it got turned into a short automatically lmao, here's a quick video showcase though
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o-iQhxVWWG8

---------PATCH NOTES-----------------

+added Margaret Thatcher as a new coffin boss

+added "Davy Crockett" (burst fire rocket launcher) as new gun

+added "Get a hyper combo (50x combo or higher)" as a new lategame challenge

+made it so on entering a new level with a combo, you have an additional 2.5 second grace period before your combo meter starts depleting. This is removed early if you kill an enemy before the grace period is over.

+Dealing damage to a boss resets the combo timer 

+Boss deaths also reset the combo meter, and add to your combo

notes.title: Release 1.5 - Patch notes
notes.content:
-Added Beta Testers names to credits :)

-FOLIE BUFF: base move speed changed from 3 (slow) to 4 (normal)

-Fixed bug where game would not save if you clicked "exit game" from the pause menu

-Made it so there's no quick restart button on your first death to encourage players to check out the character select menu

notes.title: Patch 1.4 - challenge/visual tweaks
notes.content:
-Changed default order of some uncompleted challenges to hopefully make them easier to complete for newer players (biggest change: moved 'reach reagan' challenge from the first challenge to like, mid tier)

-Made the butterfly knife an unlockable weapon instead of being available by default. It is now the first reward you receive for completing any challenge.

-Added two new blue tier guns: the "Cube Gun" and "Pellet LMG"

-Added three new challenges: finish mall 5 times, finish 30 levels across all runs, and kill 2000 enemies across all runs.

-Tweaked some visuals hue/saturation to hopefully make it more clear what's a wall vs floor

-Redid visuals on character select menu to be less eyestrain-ey

-Slightly lowered Reagan's health (85 -> 75)

-Changed overall sound volume to be a little bit quieter

I'll be releasing another small patch right around when the game releases to add all beta testers to the credits. First content update is in the works, should be released soon (tm)
